pows = [1] * 20

buckets = [[] for _ in range(10)]

def runQuery(p, s):

    global c1, sums
    tmp = ((c1 - x) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1
    c1 += 1
    sums[depth] = (sums[depth] + tmp) % MOD2
    buckets[depth].append(tmp)
    if depth == 6:

    if x > n:

    if (x + 1) * 1000000 <= n + 1 and x * 10000000 > n:

        c2 += c1
    else:

        start = 0 if x != 0 else 1
        for i in range(start, 10):
